errors.action: Could not complete the action. Please try again.
errors.downloadAll: Could not download the clips. Please try again.

toasts.clipRestyled: Clip re-rendered in the new style

clipsTotal: {count, plural, one {# clip} other {# clips}} · {duration} total
readOnly: Read-only view of another account's generation.
reconnectingOwn: Reconnecting to live updates. Your video is still processing.
reconnectingOther: Reconnecting to live updates. This generation is still processing.
cancelledBody: Retry this generation when you are ready. Your completed clips will be kept.
failedBody: Processing failed. Retry generation to try again. Your completed clips will be kept.
partialBody: {completed} clips were created, but {failed} could not be rendered. Retry generation to create only the missing clips — your finished clips are kept.
degradedBody: AI analysis was unavailable when this ran, so these moments were picked by the built-in sound-and-scene selection instead. Retry generation later to run the full AI analysis — the stand-in picks are not saved as an analysis, so the retry analyses the video properly.
noClipsBody: The generation completed but no clips were generated. The video may not have had suitable content for clipping.
downloadAllHint: Download every clip as a ZIP of the original files
settingsBody: Configure font, caption, and cleanup settings for this generation's clips.
brollBody: Add stock footage where the speaker names something you can show. Applying keeps existing B-roll and fills clips that have none; turning it off removes it.
cleanupBody: Apply silence and filler-word cuts to regenerated clips.
deleteGenerationBody: Are you sure you want to delete this generation? This will permanently delete all clips and cannot be undone.
deleteClipBody: Are you sure you want to delete this clip? This action cannot be undone.
leavePage: You can leave this page — your clips will be waiting in your library.

messages.snags: We've hit a few snags, so this is taking a little longer than usual.
messages.hiccup: A small hiccup is slowing things down. This may take a little extra time.
messages.scenicRoute: This one's taking the scenic route. It'll be a little longer than usual.
messages.bumps: A few bumps along the way. We're working through them—just a little more time.
messages.slower: Things are moving a bit slower than usual. We're still on it.

editor.title: Clip editor
editor.hint: Trim, split, reorder, or delete segments, then re-render. Edits change the real video.
editor.loadFailed: Could not load the editor for this clip.
editor.aiHint: Describe the change in plain words. The AI can only trim, split, delete, or reorder segments, change captions, or set a music track.
editor.aiPlaceholder: e.g. Make the intro shorter, drop the last segment, captions at the top

studio.title: Studio
studio.hint: Restyle this clip and re-render. Every control changes the exported video.
studio.transitionsHint: The join style used between this clip's segments.
studio.colourHint: Sliders show the grade the next render will use: your profile's look first, your changes on top.
studio.vfxHint: Effects are baked into the exported video. 0 means off.
studio.lutHint: An imported LUT replaces the profile look as the base grade; the sliders fine-tune on top of it.
studio.lutFailed: That .cube file could not be imported.

audio.title: Audio studio
audio.hint: Tune this clip's sound and re-render. Every control changes the exported audio.
audio.storedBadge: Custom audio saved for this clip
audio.voiceoverHint: A local AI narrator (Kokoro). It runs on this computer — no account, no cost. The first use downloads the voice model once (about 315 MB).
audio.scriptPlaceholder: Type the line the narrator should say…
audio.modeHook: Hook — over the opening, speech ducked
audio.voiceoverWillClear: The voiceover will be removed on the next render.

sfx.title: Sound effects
sfx.hint: Place library effects on this clip's timeline — they are mixed into the exported audio.
sfx.emptyLibrary: No SFX files yet. Add .wav or .mp3 effects to the app's assets/sfx folder and they will show up here.
sfx.none: No effects placed on this clip yet.
sfx.uploadFailed: Upload failed — the file was not added.

hookVariants.title: Hook variants
hookVariants.body: Short previews of different openings for this clip. Pick one and the full clip is re-rendered with that opening.
hookVariants.empty: No previews yet. Generate a set to compare openings.

brief.rangeNoLimits: Source {actual} — no range limits in the brief
brief.mentionNone: Not found in the transcript, captions or title copy
brief.captionChecked: Checked against the generated captions and title text
brief.noMatchTitle: No moment in the video satisfied the campaign brief
brief.noMatchBody: Jarvis searched the allowed footage and found no moment that satisfies every mandatory requirement, so no clips were made — nothing outside the brief was substituted.
brief.candidatesLine: {examined} candidate moments examined · {droppedRange} outside the allowed ranges · {droppedMandatory} failed a mandatory requirement
brief.noMatchNext: Widen the allowed range or relax a mandatory requirement, then create a new generation.
brief.droppedBanner: Campaign brief: {dropped} candidate moments were dropped ({range} outside the allowed ranges, {mandatory} failed a mandatory requirement). Only moments that satisfy the brief were made into clips.
brief.needsReviewBody: This clip contains moments the brief flagged — check them before posting. Nothing was blurred or edited automatically.
brief.rangeExcluded: This clip contains footage from a never-use range in the brief.
